generator: the AlgoLift app, scripts/indicators/classics/fixtures.mts (the strategy node's formula)
note: The AlgoLift strategy node's own formula on the cases TA-Lib was compared on (talib/obv.json, OBV). It differs from TA-Lib by a convention, so these numbers are its own: Starts at 0 on the first bar; TA-Lib starts at the first bar's volume, so every value differs from TA-Lib's by that one volume. Adds smoothed_value (an exponential average over smoothing_period) and slope, which TA-Lib does not compute.
